_README: STEP-2-VALIDATED parameters (E2b, decided 2026-08-27). This file is NOT raw TIER 3 search output. It is the 2026-08-26 nested-CV consensus with max_depth stepped 15 -> 7 by a pre-specified per-cancer validation -- TIER 3's designed-but-never-wired Step 2. BOTH steps used TRAINING DATA ONLY; there was no test-set contact at any point, which is the distinction from the hand-tuned constants this replaces (finding D-f). Methods must describe TWO selection steps, not one.
_mean_score_is_null_because: mean_score/param_stability describe a pooled nested-CV run. This configuration was not scored that way -- only max_depth differs from the config that was, and its selection metric is per-cancer OOB AUC. Populating those fields would put a number in TIER 5's provenance block that does not describe this config. See step2_validation below.

step1_pooled_nested_cv.design: 5 outer x 4 inner grouped nested CV, 500 of 1,440 grid combinations, alpha=0.5
step1_pooled_nested_cv.caveat: optimised POOLED (62,450 rows); TIER 5 fits PER-CANCER (415-14,720 rows)

step2_per_cancer_validation.design: 21 codes x 3 seeds, out-of-bag AUC, alpha=0.5 institution weights, TRAINING DATA ONLY
step2_per_cancer_validation.prespecified: 5-candidate set and selection rule fixed in code before any candidate was scored; the d5/d3 extension is recorded separately and labelled post-hoc
step2_per_cancer_validation.rule: highest mean per-cancer OOB AUC; sensitivity excludes ODG (18 minority cases) and MDLC (seed SD 0.0138); tiebreak on smaller train-OOB gap
step2_per_cancer_validation.selected: C5 = searched config with max_depth=7 (an INTERIOR optimum; d5 and d3 are worse)
step2_per_cancer_validation.honest_effect_size: AUC differences across d5/d7/d10 and the shipped constants are ~0.002, INSIDE the ~0.003 seed SD -- C5 ties the incumbent, it does not beat it. The real and consistent difference is the overfitting gap: 0.0786 vs 0.1026 for d15.

decision.lr_pathway: unchanged -- LR runs with --hyperparams-source defaults (section 7: the searched LR C is invalid)
